summary: Shifter is a self-hosted web application built with Django designed for sharing files over the web. It provides a straightforward interface centred around drag-and-drop and single-click uploading.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams who want a private, lightweight file-sharing endpoint without the complexity of a full cloud storage suite.
watchOut: Development activity is currently slowing down and it lacks the extensive ecosystem found in larger, more mature file-sharing alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your uploaded files and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
